title: Zephyr: LoRa airtime formula (SF/BW/CR/preamble/payload)
description: LoRa airtime calculation. AC: Formula matches SX127x datasheet, handles all SF/BW/CR combinations.
close_reason: Implemented overflow-checked integer SX127x airtime formula and public HAL API; exhaustive SF/BW/CR plus payload/header/CRC/LDRO/preamble tests pass in standalone C and Zephyr qemu_x86, with normative Rust vector parity. Local native_sim is unavailable on macOS because Zephyr POSIX requires Linux.
